semiconductor_relevance: High — Adelis Associates specializes in the remarketing of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment, making them a key player in the equipment segment of the semiconductor value chain.
summary: Adelis Associates Pte Ltd. is a leading remarketing agent for used semiconductor equipment, facilitating access to Asia for front-end fabrication and back-end assembly test equipment. They offer comprehensive services including refurbishment, market price evaluation, funding, leasing support, and project management.
capabilities: Remarketing of used semiconductor manufacturing equipment
Market price evaluation of used tools
